title: Verification failure grouping
responsibility: Summarizes repeated failure causes while retaining the original total count.

inputs.name: harnessFailures.failures
inputs.description: Recorded failure strings. Subject-prefixed messages with shared text can become one cause.

outputs.name: harnessFailures
outputs.description: Total failures, whether at most five allow plain display, ordered causes and omitted-cause count. Shared causes list up to three subjects; longer summaries show at most five causes.
